entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order from about two months ago for the VeloFit Pro-Pedal cycling shoes. Is that correct?
Alright. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
They just don't work for me. They're giving me blisters, and I can't seem to get the cleats positioned right. They're just terrible.
I'm sorry to hear they aren't a good fit and are causing blisters. I've just reviewed our policy. Since you received the cycling shoes 60 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window.
So I can get my money back?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method.
Fine. About time something was easy.
You should see that email within the next 5-10 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
